sentences.text: Boyz II Men is an American R&B vocal group from Philadelphia , Pennsylvania , best known for emotional ballads and acappella harmonies .	Philadelphia	Philadelphia	Pennsylvania	Pennsylvania	R&B	Contemporary R&B

Formerly a quartet including bass Michael McCary , they are currently a trio composed of baritone Nathan Morris alongside tenors Wanya Morris and Shawn Stockman .	Nathan Morris	Nathan Morris	Shawn Stockman	Shawn Stockman	Wanya Morris	Wanya Morris	Michael McCary	Michael McCary	quartet	quartet
During the 1990s , Boyz II Men found fame on Motown Records as a quartet .	Motown	Motown	Motown Records	Motown	quartet	quartet
McCary left the group in 2003 due to health issues and contractual agreements .
During the 1990s , Boyz II Men gained international success .
This began with the release of the number one single `` End of the Road '' in 1992 , which reached the top of charts worldwide .	End of the Road	End of the Road

`` End of the Road '' would set a new record for longevity , staying at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 for thirteen weeks , breaking the decades-old record held by Elvis Presley .	End of the Road	End of the Road	Elvis Presley	Elvis Presley	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

Boyz II Men proceeded to break this record with the subsequent releases of `` I 'll Make Love to You '' and `` One Sweet Day '' -LRB- with Mariah Carey -RRB- , which , at fourteen and sixteen weeks respectively , each set new records for the total number of weeks at number one .	Mariah Carey	Mariah Carey	One Sweet Day	One Sweet Day
`` I 'll Make Love to You '' also topped the charts in Australia -LRB- for four weeks -RRB- and garnered international success .
As of 2016 , `` One Sweet Day '' still holds the all-time record with sixteen weeks at the top of the Hot 100 .	One Sweet Day	One Sweet Day

Consequently , Boyz II Men are top ranking members with regard to time spent at number one in Billboard history , ranking in the fourth spot with 50 weeks -LRB- as of 2014 -RRB- .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

Furthermore , when `` On Bended Knee '' took the number one spot away from `` I 'll Make Love to You '' , Boyz II Men became only the third artists ever -LRB- after The Beatles and Presley -RRB- to replace themselves at the top of the Billboard Hot 100 .	On Bended Knee	On Bended Knee	The Beatles	The Beatles	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)

Boyz II Men are among a select group of artists that have held at the number-one spot for at least 50 weeks cumulatively , placing them just fourth on that list behind Elvis Presley , The Beatles , and Mariah Carey .	Mariah Carey	Mariah Carey	Elvis Presley	Elvis Presley	The Beatles	The Beatles
These achievements were enough to earn Boyz II Men recognition as Billboard magazine 's fourth most successful musical group of the 1990s .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)
Boyz II Men continue to perform worldwide , as a trio .
Their most recent studio album , Collide , was released in 2014 .	Collide	Collide (Boyz II Men album)
